title: Atomically Precise Lanthanide-Iron-Oxo Clusters Featuring the e-Keggin Ion

material_class.structural_family: Lanthanide–iron–oxo cluster with an ε-{Fe13} Keggin core

synthesis.procedure: Dissolve trans-4-hydroxy-L-proline, Fe(ClO4)3·9H2O and Y(ClO4)3 in acetonitrile and ethanol. Add triethanolamine, reflux for 2 h, filter while hot, and allow the filtrate to evaporate in air. Collect polyhedral reddish-brown crystals after approximately one week.
synthesis.temperature: Reflux; filtrate subsequently evaporated in air
synthesis.time: 2 h reflux; approximately one week for crystals
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Hot filtration followed by evaporation of the filtrate in air; polyhedral reddish-brown crystals.

properties.summary: Magnetic susceptibility indicates antiferromagnetic coupling among iron ions.

measurements.name: χMT maximum
measurements.conditions: On cooling below 200 K; 1000 Oe dc field; peak temperature not legible in Markdown

source_locations.location: Synthesis and structures of compounds 1–4, Figures 1–4

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: A discrete 45-metal cluster centered on an ε-{Fe13} Keggin iron–oxo unit. The reported metal skeleton is described as a central Fe ion, a cage-like Fe16 middle shell, and a fullerene-like Y12Fe16 outer shell.

synthesis.procedure: Use the procedure for Y12Fe33, substituting Gd(ClO4)3 for Y(ClO4)3: dissolve it with trans-4-hydroxy-L-proline and Fe(ClO4)3·9H2O in acetonitrile and ethanol, add triethanolamine, reflux for 2 h, filter hot, and evaporate the filtrate in air. Collect hexagonal reddish-brown crystals after approximately one week.
synthesis.temperature: Reflux; filtrate subsequently evaporated in air
synthesis.time: 2 h reflux; approximately one week for crystals
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Hot filtration followed by evaporation of the filtrate in air; hexagonal reddish-brown crystals.

properties.summary: The susceptibility trend indicates strong Fe–Fe antiferromagnetic interactions and low-temperature ferromagnetic contributions involving Gd and Fe.

synthesis.procedure: Use the Y12Fe33 procedure but replace Fe(ClO4)3·9H2O with Fe(NO3)3·9H2O. Dissolve the iron salt, Y(ClO4)3 and trans-4-hydroxy-L-proline in acetonitrile and ethanol, add triethanolamine, reflux for 2 h, filter hot, and evaporate the filtrate in air. Collect block-shaped reddish-brown crystals after approximately two weeks.
